sections.heading: What we make
paragraphs: Soy wax, cotton wicks and scents we mix ourselves, poured a few dozen at a time in a back room that always smells like cedar. Every candle burns clean for as long as the label says.
Order online, pick up at the counter. We don't ship: small batches, small shop.
